questions.q: What was the first problem with this fifth trip in the jolly-boat?
choices: The boat was badly overloaded
The boat had a hole in it
They had forgotten the oars
It was far too dark to see the shore
questions.evidence: the little gallipot of a boat that we were in was gravely overloaded

questions.q: What was the second danger the boat faced?
choices: A strong ebb current swept them off course
A sudden storm blew in from the sea
Sharks began circling the boat
Thick fog hid the shore
questions.evidence: we were swept out of our true course

questions.q: Why did the captain refuse to let the current carry them ashore wherever it wanted?
choices: They might land beside the pirates' gigs and be caught
The beach there was covered in sharp rocks
He wanted to get back to the ship again
The current would carry them far out to sea and drown them
questions.evidence: besides the chance of being boarded by the gigs

questions.q: How did the doctor and the others decide to treat Abraham Gray?
choices: Like one of themselves
As a prisoner to be watched
As a servant who must row
As a spy for Silver
questions.evidence: we had all quietly made up our minds to treat him like one of ourselves

questions.q: What did the captain suddenly realize the pirates on the ship were preparing?
choices: The long nine cannon
The ship's sails
A second jolly-boat to chase them
A raft
questions.evidence: We had entirely forgotten the long nine

questions.q: Who did Gray warn had been Flint's gunner?
choices: Israel Hands
Long John Silver
Job Anderson
Tom Redruth

questions.q: When Squire Trelawney fired at Israel Hands, what happened?
choices: Hands stooped, and another pirate was hit instead
Hands was killed at once and fell from the ship's rail
The squire's gun failed to fire
The shot struck the ship's mast
questions.evidence: just as Trelawney fired, down he stooped, the ball whistled over him

questions.q: "The ebb-tide, which had so cruelly delayed us, was now making reparation." Here "making reparation" means:
choices: Making up for the harm it had done
Getting stronger and more dangerous
Turning into a storm
Stopping completely
questions.evidence: was now making reparation and delaying our assailants

questions.q: What happened to the jolly-boat when the cannon fired?
choices: It sank by the stern in about three feet of water
It was blown to pieces by the cannon shot
It drifted out to sea and was lost
It reached the beach safely
questions.evidence: the boat sank by the stern, quite gently, in three feet of water

questions.q: How many of the five guns were still usable after the boat sank?
choices: Two
Five
None
Four
questions.evidence: only two guns out of five remained in a state for service

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: The overloaded jolly-boat's last trip ends with it sinking
The pirates attack and capture the stockade from the woods
Jim and Ben Gunn row out to the ship at night
The doctor makes peace with the mutineers
questions.evidence: leaving behind us the poor jolly-boat and a good half of all our powder and provisions
